Select a visible opponent to inspect a shot.

Prototype coverage

Movement, combat, guard turns and reload use the current sprite game rules. Characters walk between tiles and settle into their equipment carry poses. Rifles now raise, fire with recoil and show their shot path. Select Anya to try it. Stance controls use the sprite rules. Shift-drag selects a group; Shift-click toggles a merc. Ground clicks move the group; Fire, Reload and stance buttons use the primary merc. Other weapon animations, climbing, inventory and campaign UI are next.

Easy reveals scenery. Opponents still require detection in line of sight. Unseen loot is not revealed.
